The '''''Diligent''''' was a [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser]] serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] between the battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]].

It was present alongside the [[Assault Frigate Mark I|Assault Frigate]] [[Haven (Assault Frigate)|''Haven'']] at the Rebel base known as [[Lost Station]] where new recruit [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] underwent his piloting evaluations supervised by his future [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] [[Olin Garn]].
